title: Composed supervisory control: Alternating two-pump starts -> Fair two-client resource arbiter with emergency lockout

inputs.name: B_RequestA
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Client A requests the resource

inputs.name: B_RequestB
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Client B requests the resource

inputs.name: B_Done
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Current client releases the resource

outputs.name: A_NextPump
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Preferred pump for next demand: 1 or 2

outputs.name: A_Unavailable
outputs.description: Subsystem A: No available pump for demand

outputs.name: B_GrantA
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource grant to client A

outputs.name: B_GrantB
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource grant to client B

outputs.name: B_Busy
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource has an active owner

outputs.name: B_Turn
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Tie-break preference: 1 A, 2 B

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Each rising A_Demand shall start at most one available pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: When both pumps are available, successive A_Demand episodes shall alternate the selected pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: If the preferred pump is A_Unavailable, the other available pump shall run.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Unavailable shall be TRUE exactly when A_Demand is TRUE and neither pump is available.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset without A_Demand shall set A_NextPump to 1 and stop both pumps.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_GrantA and B_GrantB shall never be TRUE simultaneously.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When idle, a single request shall receive the resource; simultaneous requests shall follow B_Turn.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((!B_Busy AND request_present AND !B_LockedOut) -> X(B_Busy)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Done shall release the resource before a new owner is selected on a later scan.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: After A completes B_Turn shall prefer B, and after B completes B_Turn shall prefer A.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Done AND B_GrantA)->X(B_Turn=2))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Done AND B_GrantB)->X(B_Turn=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Emergency shall immediately revoke all grants and latch B_LockedOut.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Emergency -> (!B_GrantA AND !B_GrantB AND !B_Busy AND B_LockedOut)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_LockedOut only while B_Emergency and both requests are FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND !B_Emergency AND !B_RequestA AND !B_RequestB) -> !B_LockedOut))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Pump1Run shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_GrantA AND NOT B_GrantB AND NOT B_Busy AND B_Turn=0 AND NOT B_LockedOut)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_GrantA AND NOT B_GrantB AND NOT B_Busy AND B_Turn=0 AND NOT B_LockedOut))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
